product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx provides large organizations with an AI-powered employee-experience platform that connects workforce listening, learning, and activation to turn employee insights into action, behavior change, and measurable capability.

pricing_page.notes: The cited review reports no pricing page on perceptyx.com and that its /pricing URL returned 404 as of August 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog has multiple technical posts; examples include a sentiment-model build article coauthored by its AI/data engineering lead and an earlier post by a VP of Engineering and the Head of AI & Data Science.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal has API guides and multiple reference articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists open roles in sales development and strategic expansion, with no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: The company describes these as providers/subprocessors for optional generative-AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page specifies SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.

raised_18mo.notes: The database lists the latest funding round as a Series A on 2019-11-25, before the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page and live posting list an Enterprise Sales Development Representative role.

launched_6mo.notes: Perceptyx announced the launch of Perceptyx Anywhere on 2026-09-29, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mary Poppen states that she joined as Chief Customer Officer in June 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A marketing-operations posting explicitly describes Salesforce administration and Salesforce CRM duties; the posting is no longer live.
